question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer logs all occurrences of a configuration being saved. The engineer must generate an additional log message when someone attempts to change the configuration for interface Ethernet 1/1. Which set of commands must be used to meet these requirements?
context:
event manager applet ConfigMgmt
  event cli match "copy run start"
  action 1 syslog priority warnings msg Configuration Modified
options:
event manager applet ConfigMgmt
  event cli tag eth match "interface Ethernet1/1"
  event cli tag copy match "copy run start"
  event cli tag conf match "configure terminal"
  tag conf and eth or copy happens 1 in 4294967295
  action 1 syslog priority warnings msg Configuration Modified

event manager applet ConfigMgmt
  event cli tag eth match "interface Ethernet1/1"
  event cli tag copy match "copy run start"
  event cli tag conf match "configure terminal"
  tag conf or eth or copy happens 2 in 3
  action 1 syslog priority warnings msg Configuration Modified
  action 2 event-default

event manager applet ConfigMgmt
  event cli tag eth match " configure terminal ; interface Ethernet1/1"
  event cli tag copy match "copy run start"
  tag eth or copy happens 1 in 2
  action 1 syslog priority warnings msg Configuration Modified
  action 2 event-default

event manager applet ConfigMgmt
  event cli tag eth match " configure terminal ; interface Ethernet1/1"
  event cli tag copy match "copy run start"
  tag eth and copy happens 1 in 2
  action 1 syslog priority warnings msg Configuration Modified
